definition.def: If you talk about a likely or possible scenario, you are talking about the way in which a situation may develop.
examples: ...the nightmare scenario of a divided and irrelevant Royal Family. [+ of]
In the worst-case scenario, you could become a homeless person.
Try to imagine all the possible scenarios and what action you would take.

definition.def: The scenario of a film is a piece of writing that gives an outline of the story.
